flakeFinding.what: The new `retires a ready-time worker whose socket closes … (workerCap 1|2)` tests are timing-sensitive on a loaded box (loadavg ~110–130 here). Whole-file `bun test src/daemon/__tests__/processes.test.ts` on head: 6 pass / 2 fail over 8 runs, and 3 of an earlier 3 runs each had one cap variant fail (263 pass / 1 fail); solo `-t` runs: cap 1 failed 2 of 17, cap 2 0 of 8.
